label: Core Engineering Focus
headline: AI as efficient as it is intelligent.
bio: I build backend systems and take AI into production, and own each system from design to support: payments that never double-charge, agents that act within guardrails, and models sized to the latency budget and hardware they run on.

pillars.title: Tool-Using Agents
pillars.description: Agents built as production software: typed tools, fail-closed guardrails, and a named operator behind every change they make.

pillars.title: Resource-Aware AI
pillars.description: Trains and distils models on GPU, then serves small, quantized models on CPU that meet tight latency budgets without wasted compute.

pillars.title: Backend Systems
pillars.description: Java and Spring Boot services that charge exactly once, split revenue with a full audit trail and stream events into analytics, owned from API design to production support.
